title: Psionic program: some assets are abductees

tellings.quote: In fact I was told we know for a fact >> that some of our assets are abductees.

plain: Tim Alberino, a guest who tells Michels about secret military matters, says he was told about a psionic programme, meaning one that uses people's claimed psychic or mind powers, and that some of the people it works with are alien abductees. In his words, he was told "we know for a fact that some of our assets are abductees." He tells it as something said to him directly. If true, the government would be knowingly using people who say they were taken by non-human beings.
